weeks.content:
Say my full name
Say my class and my teacher's name

Greet in the morning and in the evening
Greet our elders the right way

Point to my body parts
My body is private to me

Name the people in my family
Draw my family

Share crayons with a partner
Say please and thank you

What to do when we hurt a friend
Say sorry and make up

Listen to our class rules
Walk, do not run

Wait for my turn on the slide
Take turns with the toy

Put waste in the bin
Arrange chairs after play

Act greeting, sharing and sorry
Say our class rules
